For n>=5, verified the actual cubical active-set cell counts C0=2^n,C1=n2^(n-1),C2=n2^(n-2) and the coefficient-product fundamental 2-cycle: at each oriented 1-cell the two square boundaries cancel, giving top homology Q and its rotation +1/reflection -1 orientation character. Fixed-cell traces under a nonidentity r^k are (2^gcd(n,k),0,0), giving H1 trace 2-2^gcd. Odd reflections give (2^q,2^(q-1),-2^(q-1)); even vertex- and edge-reflections give (2^q,2^q,0) or (2^q,0,-2^q), all with alternating sum zero. Identity gives dim H1=2+(n-4)2^(n-2). Prime p traces vanish off identity and the resulting rational character is the regular D_p character times the stated integer multiplicity. Checked source verify_polygon.py, its finite n=5..14 trace tests and n=5..10 boundary enumeration; finite range is supplementary, uniform argument is the proof. The n=5 case is separately known.
